selected_schema_columns.description: The calendar year in which the event occurred.
selected_schema_columns.name: Year

selected_schema_columns.description: A 2000 character field used to describe the details of the event.
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Description

selected_schema_columns.description: A unique system-generated identification number for each Major Safety Event.
selected_schema_columns.name: Incident Number

selected_schema_columns.description: The date on which the event occurred.
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Date

selected_schema_columns.description: The actual time of day the event occurred.
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Time

selected_schema_columns.description: The type of event that occurred. Collision with person events are transformed from a collision type based on the following circumstances: “Attempted Suicide” if the person survives or “Suicide”, if they pass away. Collision with person events where the person was pushed in front of an oncoming transit vehicle is [Assault or Homicide] on [person type]. Derailment events are transformed to “Yard Derailment” or “Main Line Derailment” based on location of derailment. Non-transit collisions involving non-revenue property (events where agency property other than revenue vehicles were involved) are transformed to “Other”.
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Type

selected_schema_columns.description: A derived column to allow users to filter based on broader event type (e.g., Collision, Derailment, Assault).
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Type Group

selected_schema_columns.description: Indicates whether the person assaulted is a transit operator, other transit worker, not a transit worker, or not specified. Only applies to assaults.
selected_schema_columns.name: Transit Worker Type

selected_schema_columns.description: Identifies the type of assault on a transit worker as physical, non-physical, or not specified. Only applies to assaults.
selected_schema_columns.name: Transit Worker Assault Detail Type

selected_schema_columns.description: When the value is True, the event is reported as an Assault on Transit Worker of any type. Otherwise, the value is false. Note, the value will appear as False for all events prior to 2023.
selected_schema_columns.name: Transit Worker Assault Flag

selected_schema_columns.description: Text explanation from the 'Please describe" box used when "Other Security Event " is selected
selected_schema_columns.name: Other Event Type Description

selected_schema_columns.description: Overall category of the event type
selected_schema_columns.name: Event Category

selected_schema_columns.description: Identifier of events involving a runaway train.  [A train which is no longer under the control of a driver regardless of whether the operator is physically on the vehicle at the time. This is limited to revenue vehicles.]
selected_schema_columns.name: Runaway Train Flag

selected_schema_columns.description: Identifier of a Safety (SFT) or (Security Event). [Safety Event: A collision, derailment, fire, hazardous material spill, act of nature (Act of God), evacuation, or OSONOC occurring on transit right-of-way, in a transit revenue facility, in a transit maintenance facility, or involving a transit revenue vehicle and meeting established NTD thresholds.] OR [Security event: An occurrence of a bomb threat, bombing, arson, hijacking, sabotage, cyber security event, assault, robbery, rape, burglary, suicide, attempted suicide (not involving a transit vehicle), larceny, theft, vandalism, homicide, CBR (chemical/biological/radiological) or nuclear release, or other event.]
selected_schema_columns.name: Safety/Security

selected_schema_columns.description: Identifies what the transit vehicle collided with: Motor Vehicle, Non-Transit Motor Vehicle, Non-Rail Transit Vehicle, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Passenger Train – Revenue Service, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Passenger Train – Not in Revenue Service, Rail Transit Vehicle/Rail Transit Maintenance or Service Vehicle on the rail fixed guideway, Person, Animal, Fixed Object, Transit vehicle, Vessel, Dock/Terminal center, Non-revenue vehicle, Other.
selected_schema_columns.name: Collision With

selected_schema_columns.description: Non-rail mode: The estimated dollar value of all property that is damaged in a Reportable Event. This includes transit-owned property and other vehicles and property involved in the event that are not owned by the transit agency (excludes personal property such as cell phones and computers). Property damage also includes the cost of clearing wreckage.
selected_schema_columns.name: Property Damage

selected_schema_columns.description: When a value is reported, this indicates Substantial Damage, which is defined as damage to transit or non-transit property including vehicles, facilities, equipment, rolling stock, or infrastructure that disrupts the operations of the rail transit agency and adversely affects the structural strength, performance, or operating characteristics of the property, requiring towing, rescue, on-site maintenance, or immediate removal prior to safe operation.
selected_schema_columns.name: Substantial Property Damage Type

selected_schema_columns.description: Flag indicating that damage to a rail transit vehicle resulted from a collision and prevented the vehicle from operating under its own power.
